name: Paste images onto Stories in the TUI with an Attachments tab
description:
Part of the Epic `clipboard-image-attachments`; read its description first. It needs the `storyPaste` hook and the Attachments Plugin from the Stories that block it.

## Goal

The full user flow in the TUI: copy a screenshot, open a Story or the new-Story form, press the paste key, and the image is attached.

## Work

- **Claim `storyPaste`** in the Attachments Plugin:
  - `story`: run `attachments.add` at once. Toast `Attached image-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.png (412 KB)`, and reload the Attachments tab.
  - `form`: keep the image in memory, not on disk. Show an `Attachments` row on the Story form, e.g. `2 images (612 KB)`, through `PluginStoryForm`. The images are written in the same operation that creates or edits the Story, so cancelling the form saves nothing. `esc` on a form with pending images asks to discard them (`useDirty`).
- **Attachments tab** on the Story screen:
  - a list with name, size and date;
  - `n` adds a file from a path (the "n creates" rule);
  - `o` opens the selected file;
  - `d` removes it after a `ConfirmDialog`.

  It reloads on return (`useReloadOnReturn`) following the rules in AGENTS.md: show `<Loading />` only when there is no data yet, and don't gate `useInput` on `loading`.
- **Badge** on Story cards and list rows, e.g. `📎 2`, from the bag (`storyBadges`/`cardBadge`, no file reads).
- Follow `.agents/skills/rowbly-tui-design/SKILL.md`; one component per file.

## Docs

- `docs/user-guide.md`:
  - the paste keys on each platform;
  - the screenshot shortcuts that copy to the clipboard: macOS Cmd+Ctrl+Shift+4 (Cmd+Shift+4 saves a file instead), Windows Win+Shift+S, Linux depends on the desktop;
  - `wl-clipboard` for sway and Hyprland users;
  - troubleshooting: SSH, headless, unsupported platforms, and the `rowbly attachment add` fallback.
- The Attachments sections in `docs/plugins/built-in.md` and `skills/rowbly/references/tui.md`.

## Verify

Run it with `pnpm dev` on this machine:
- paste on an open Story;
- paste on the new-Story form, then cancel and then save;
- remove an attachment.

Take screenshots with agentic-tui following `.agents/skills/rowbly-screenshots/SKILL.md`, and don't commit them. No new tests by default.

## Done when

`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test:unit` and `pnpm test:cli` all pass.
